terms.label: Standard Model
terms.definition: The theoretical framework describing the electromagnetic, weak, and strong interactions between elementary particles.

terms.label: Elementary particle
terms.definition: A subatomic particle that is not composed of other particles.

terms.label: Fermion
terms.definition: A particle that obeys Fermi-Dirac statistics and has half-integer spin.

terms.label: Quark
terms.definition: An elementary particle and a fundamental constituent of matter, carrying fractional electric charge.

terms.label: Up quark
terms.definition: A light quark with electric charge +2/3, denoted by the symbol u.

terms.label: Down quark
terms.definition: A light quark with electric charge -1/3, denoted by the symbol d.

terms.label: Charm quark
terms.definition: A heavy quark with electric charge +2/3, denoted by the symbol c.

terms.label: Lepton
terms.definition: An elementary particle that does not undergo strong interactions.

terms.label: Electron
terms.definition: A subatomic particle with a negative elementary electric charge.

terms.label: Muon
terms.definition: An elementary particle similar to the electron but with a greater mass.

terms.label: Neutrino
terms.definition: An electrically neutral elementary particle with very small mass that interacts only via the weak force.

terms.label: Boson
terms.definition: A particle that obeys Bose-Einstein statistics and has integer spin.

terms.label: Gauge boson
terms.definition: A force carrier that mediates fundamental interactions.

terms.label: Photon
terms.definition: The quantum of the electromagnetic field, mediating electromagnetic interactions.

terms.label: Gluon
terms.definition: The quantum of the strong interaction, mediating the force between quarks.

terms.label: W boson
terms.definition: A massive gauge boson mediating the weak nuclear interaction.

terms.label: Z boson
terms.definition: A massive neutral gauge boson mediating the weak nuclear interaction.

terms.label: Higgs boson
terms.definition: An elementary particle responsible for giving other particles mass via the Higgs mechanism.

terms.label: Hadron
terms.definition: A composite particle made of quarks held together by the strong force.

terms.label: Baryon
terms.definition: A composite subatomic particle made of three quarks.
